_status: DRAFT v0 - ASG-014, unapproved. Transition table is a proposal; the Blueprint (3.1) fixes the states and the principles, not every edge.
notes: A failed record stores the failed operation and the previous state; only the matching retry edge is allowed for that operation.

Validation failures during install_requested (dependencies, compatibility, permissions, configuration, migration plan) leave the app in 'available' with the errors recorded and an audit event; they do not enter 'installing'.
At most one lifecycle operation per (tenant, app) at a time.
Rollback vs forward-fix after a failed upgrade is an undecided policy (Blueprint 22) - not encoded here.
